hook: Hide spiders under Lids beside cheap fodder, then watch a single death spring the whole ambush.
loop: Place Lurkers beside fodder to ambush, or alone in gaps to wait.
Hidden Lurkers stay Patient and grow; Springs chain and bank stats.
A neighbour's death Springs them: free strikes, or a grown second board.

growth.line: Patient Lurkers grow permanently each Start of Turn; each Spring banks stats; Mabyn merges both late.

feel.early: Money Spider carries fights; Tapwell grows either way.
feel.mid: Arranging gaps and neighbours; first Spring chains appear.
feel.late: Mabyn merges builds; Master replays every Spring for the finale.

stars.why: Hidden, knocked, comes up with Spiderlings that are the next knocks.
Closes Lids again, so the same knocks fire twice.
Capstone: Sprang Lurkers count as Patient, merging both builds.

card_short.u01: Fodder; leaves a Spiderling when it dies, another knock.
card_short.u02: Lurk. Grows permanently while Patient and whenever it Springs.
card_short.u03: Gives another friendly unit Lurk permanently.
card_short.u04: Each turn, buffs your lowest-Attack Lurker permanently.
card_short.u05: Gold each turn for a Patient Lurker, and for Springs.
card_short.u07: Start of Combat: Springs your leftmost other hidden Lurker.
card_short.u08: Buffs all your Lurkers permanently, or gives one unit Lurk.
card_short.u09: A Spring wakes neighbouring hidden Lurkers too, with a buff.
card_short.u10: Neighbouring Lurkers' Spring effects trigger twice.
card_short.u11: Twice a fight: a hidden Lurker Springs at an attacker.
card_short.u12: Every Spring permanently buffs the Lurker that Sprang.
card_short.u13: Each turn, buffs your Patient Lurkers permanently.
card_short.u14: Lurk. After a Spring attack, the Lurker hides again once.
card_short.u15: Spring attacks deal double damage and Cleave.
card_short.u16: Lurk. Spring: summons three Spiderlings that also Lurk.
card_short.u17: Lurk. Sprang Lurkers stay Patient; buffs Patient Lurkers each turn.
card_short.u18: Lurk. Springs last, replaying every Spring effect this fight.
card_short.u19: Gives Lurk; Springing Lurkers repeat their Start of Combat effects.
card_short.x01: 1/1 token; fodder that knocks the Lurkers next to it.

builds.name: The Ambush
builds.line: Fodder beside Lurkers; each death Springs chains of summons and strikes.

builds.name: The Patient Lodge
builds.line: Shown front wins; hidden Lurkers grow in gaps, rising when it breaks.

builds.name: The Open Lodge
builds.line: Give Lurk to other tribes' units; Start of Combat effects fire twice.

liked: Where Lurkers sit, beside fodder or alone in gaps, is a real puzzle.
A hidden board woken by neighbours' deaths plays unlike today's tribes; Corkhinge stands out.
worries: Orbweaver: an all-Lurker board fires double-damage Cleave hits before the enemy moves.
Worshipful Master: huge with golden Diadem and Corkhinge, and its text is a paragraph.
changed: Only a Lurker under its Lid can Spring, so chains end.
Tapwell also grows on Spring; Ballot Clerk now pays the Ambush build too.
Worshipful Master now Springs only by its own rule; its Lid shows repeats.
verdict: Made for fans of positional puzzles and ambush chains: hide spiders, then let one death spring them.
